_comment: Admin settings. Edit this file and push -- no code changes needed. The workflow re-reads it on every run.
_pull_window_minutes_comment: How close to a scheduled pull_time the workflow's cron tick has to land to count as that pull. The workflow runs every 10 minutes, so 20 gives it two tries to catch each scheduled time.
_morning_pull_time_comment: Must exactly match one entry in pull_times. This is the pull that also fetches closing odds + final scores + grading for yesterday's games.
_pull_window_hours_comment: How far ahead each pull looks for upcoming games (startsAfter=now, startsBefore=now+this many hours).
_leagues_comment: league_id/sport_id values are SportsGameOdds API identifiers. NFL, NBA, and MLB are confirmed against the docs; NCAAF, NCAAB, and NHL follow the same naming convention but haven't been confirmed against a live response yet -- run scripts/verify_leagues.py once you have an API key and fix any that don't match. Set enabled:false to stop pulling a league without deleting it.
_markets_comment: sp=spread, ml=moneyline, ou=total(over/under). Full game only (periodID=game) for Prompt 1.
_opener_min_books_comment: A game's Opener line is locked in from the first pull where at least this many sportsbooks have a price posted for that market.
_monthly_api_call_limit_comment: Enter your plan's monthly call budget here. The admin page compares actual usage against this and warns at 80%.
